method: Lossless crop and opaque RGB black masks; no generative reconstruction; originals preserved
coordinate_convention: Original-image pixels, half-open [left, top, right, bottom]

screenshots.caption_en: urlscan summary excerpt for ehazinesorgula[.]com: 9 HTTP transactions and an institution-themed page preview. The scan record reports 13 October 2026 11:24:43 UTC; the timestamp is outside this crop.
screenshots.edits_en: Cropped away the site/account header, submitted URLs and live-DNS panel. Opaque masks remove remaining live domain/IP strings and the miniature page header. No text was reconstructed.
screenshots.limitations_en: Historical scan summary, not current availability. Cloudflare edge attribution does not identify the origin or operator; the embedded page preview is small.

screenshots.caption_en: urlscan HTTP-resource list: successful page/assets requests, a 404 favicon request and a POST to Cloudflare /cdn-cgi/rum returning 204.
screenshots.edits_en: Opaque masks remove raw domain/URL/IP values, secondary resource paths and an unnecessary script identifier. Request methods, status codes and useful resource names remain.
screenshots.limitations_en: The POST shown is telemetry, not a credential submission or evidence of successful exfiltration.

screenshots.caption_en: urlscan reports 29 structurally similar hits. Candidate-domain labels are removed; the experimental-feature warning and part of the results table remain.
screenshots.edits_en: Cropped away the live effective URL and submission header; an opaque mask removes the candidate URL column.
screenshots.limitations_en: Only part of the results list is visible. Structural similarity does not establish shared content, a common operator or maliciousness.

screenshots.caption_en: Fake e-Devlet login appearance with empty Turkish national ID and password fields, originally shown at ehazinesorgula[.]com/giris.
screenshots.edits_en: Cropped away browser chrome, bookmarks, the live address and footer. An opaque mask removes the domain/URL displayed in the upper-right imitation branding.
screenshots.limitations_en: The fields are empty. This image shows impersonation and collection intent, not a form submission or successful transfer. The source address is outside the crop.

screenshots.caption_en: DevTools screenshot shows a selected POST to proxy_query.php with request fields password, tc and tcKimlik. All values are removed.
screenshots.edits_en: Cropped away browser/account panels and unrelated traffic. Opaque masks remove the domain column, non-selected request details and every credential/identity value.
screenshots.limitations_en: Screenshot-only evidence of the same-site POST; this POST is absent from E09 HAR. No response body or completed external API transfer is shown, and test-data status is unverified.

screenshots.caption_en: Client-visible settings response retains field names, enabled flags and GET methods. Endpoint, secret, identity, contact and payment values are removed.
screenshots.edits_en: Cropped to the response panel, excluding the account header and network table. Opaque masks remove phone, API endpoint/token values, bank/account/IBAN details, amount, case value and address API endpoint/token values.
screenshots.limitations_en: The original configures turkeysystems[.]org/tc-api; this derivative hides endpoint values. Configuration does not prove a successful identity lookup, password transfer or payment.

screenshots.caption_en: HTML excerpt shows a POST login form with action giris-yap and a password input named auth_key; no entered key is visible.
screenshots.edits_en: No pixel masks or crop required after review; publication uses a metadata-stripped re-encoded derivative.
screenshots.limitations_en: Host, URL and HTTP status are absent from the original image. The service attribution in its filename is not independently verified by this excerpt.

screenshots.caption_en: Narrow static-code excerpt shows the local ./api/proxy_query.php fetch, POST method and JSON identity/password field names.
screenshots.edits_en: Cropped to the request-code lines. The entire account/settings area containing translucent secret and personal-data residues is outside the crop; no sensitive values were reconstructed.
screenshots.limitations_en: The crop truncates longer code lines and omits fallback/error handling. Static code does not establish server proxy contents or a completed external API transfer.

screenshots.caption_en: Response excerpt: HTTP 200 with JSON MessageCode ERROR stating that auth or national ID parameters are missing; server Date is 20 October 2026 14:51:59 GMT.
screenshots.edits_en: Cropped away the request/client panel. An opaque mask removes telemetry URLs and request tracking/timing identifiers while retaining status, basic response headers and the application error.
screenshots.limitations_en: The original is an analyst request to turkeysystems[.]org/tc-api. HTTP 200 is not successful identity lookup; server Date does not establish acquisition time. The host is outside the crop.

screenshots.caption_en: Fallback-code excerpt conditionally adds Authorization and X-API-Key headers and takes the request method from configuration; no key value is present in the retained code.
screenshots.edits_en: Narrow crop excludes the account header and the entire lower settings area containing translucent API secrets, personal identifiers, phone and bank data.
screenshots.limitations_en: The retained crop omits request-body construction, GET URL construction and response handling. Code capability does not prove that this fallback executed.

screenshots.caption_en: Port-response comparison excerpt: 80/8080 return 301, 443 redirects to /giris-yap and 8443 returns Cloudflare 521. Original target: turkeysystems[.]org.
screenshots.edits_en: Cropped away commands and the unrelated transparent response background. Opaque masks remove live Location URLs and a residual interface fragment.
screenshots.limitations_en: Historical analyst probes against a Cloudflare edge; these responses do not identify the origin server or prove a working application on 8443.

screenshots.caption_en: Dated DNS output retains NXDOMAIN and the terminal time, 18 October 2026 11:18:43 +03. The queried name is obscured; its exact spelling could not be established from the original pixels.
screenshots.edits_en: Cropped to the result/time region and applied extensive opaque masks to the queried name, DNS transaction details, resolver data and transparent bank/API background. Only the NXDOMAIN result and terminal date strip remain visible.
screenshots.limitations_en: One resolver response at one time; the exact queried name remains uncertain. This derivative cannot establish a target-domain takedown or DNS change. Removed content is not reconstructed.

screenshots.caption_en: An undated dig A-record query originally showed turkeysystems[.]org resolving to 104[.]21[.]1[.]166 and 172[.]67[.]129[.]163. Live network values are obscured in the image.
screenshots.edits_en: Opaque masks cover the queried live domain and both live IP address results. No substitute text or network value is inserted into the image.
screenshots.limitations_en: No timestamp or resolver is shown. The caption records only the original observation; present-day DNS state and the origin server are not verified.

screenshots.caption_en: Historical Team Cymru output maps 104[.]21[.]1[.]166 to Cloudflare AS13335. The query domain, IP and BGP prefix are obscured; ASN, network organization and allocation date remain visible.
screenshots.edits_en: Opaque masks cover the live lookup-service domain, queried IP, returned IP and BGP network prefix.
screenshots.limitations_en: Cloudflare is shared proxy infrastructure. This does not identify an origin server, operator or attacker location; the allocation date is not an attack date.

screenshots.caption_en: Historical Team Cymru output maps 172[.]67[.]129[.]163 to Cloudflare AS13335. The lookup domain, IP and BGP prefix are obscured.
screenshots.edits_en: Cropped out the analyst username/host/path and bottom background. Opaque masks cover the lookup-service domain, queried IP, returned IP and BGP network prefix.
screenshots.limitations_en: The same shared proxy network as E19; this is not dated DNS or origin-server verification. The network allocation date is not campaign onset.

screenshots.caption_en: A narrow crop preserves three 403 status examples from historical directory discovery against turkeysystems[.]org. The target, path names and transparent background outside this result column are excluded.
screenshots.edits_en: Extensive crop to a small status-code result column removes live target URLs, analyst discovery configuration, path names and the wider transparent code/process background. No text is synthesized.
screenshots.limitations_en: Only example 403 statuses remain in this derivative. The complete reviewed original contains other redirects/statuses described in the audit. A 403 response does not establish that a sensitive file exists; no raw-response or wildcard check is supplied.

screenshots.caption_en: Historical WHOIS for turkeysystems[.]org retains creation, update and expiration dates and non-domain registrar context. Live domains, contact details and registration identifiers are obscured.
screenshots.edits_en: Cropped surrounding margins. Opaque masks cover domain names, nameservers, URLs, WHOIS hosts, email/phone contacts, domain-like registrar labels and the registry identifier.
screenshots.limitations_en: Registration history does not establish attacker identity, first misuse or continuity of ownership. The creation date is not phishing onset.

screenshots.caption_en: WHOIS for ehazinesorgula[.]com retains the creation time, 13 October 2026 09:38:56 UTC, registrar and expiry context. Domain, registrant/contact values and registration identifiers are obscured.
screenshots.edits_en: Cropped margins and applied opaque masks to live domains/URLs/nameservers, registrant country/identifiers, email/phone contacts and registry domain identifiers.
screenshots.limitations_en: Although the original filename mentions DNS, this image contains WHOIS only. Creation time does not establish the start of phishing; registrant information does not identify an attacker or location.

screenshots.caption_en: Certificate-search results for ehazinesorgula[.]com and its wildcard retain issuer, validity and as-of dates. The second result is labeled precert; live domain values are obscured.
screenshots.edits_en: Opaque masks cover every displayed domain occurrence in titles, SAN names, certificate-name matches and subject fields. Issuer, validity dates and precertificate labeling remain unchanged.
screenshots.limitations_en: Full certificates and fingerprints are absent. These results do not prove concurrent presentation of both certificates or that the site content was trustworthy.

screenshots.caption_en: Burp history for turkeysystems[.]org shows membership pages, a crypto-payment creation endpoint and repeated payment-status checks. Live hosts and query tails are obscured.
screenshots.edits_en: Cropped out the messaging-profile row and blank lower area. Opaque masks cover all live host values, a telemetry resource identifier and payment-query tails. Methods, endpoint paths and HTTP statuses remain visible.
screenshots.limitations_en: This is analyst interaction with the external service, not proof of a phishing-victim payment. E26 and E27 are details of the same flow rather than independent corroboration.

screenshots.caption_en: An external-service response dated 22 October 2026 06:41:14 GMT creates a 3.10 USDT/TRC20 membership payment request. Payment token and wallet address are obscured.
screenshots.edits_en: Cropped to the JSON response and date-bearing inspector panel, removing request hosts and most telemetry headers. Opaque masks cover remaining tracking headers, the full payment-token value and wallet address. Field names and non-sensitive payment-state context remain visible.
screenshots.limitations_en: Payment creation is not a completed transfer, wallet-ownership proof or phishing revenue. The expiry field does not state its timezone. The following observed check in E27 remains pending.

screenshots.caption_en: The payment-check JSON reports pending and awaiting payment for 3.10 USDT. It is the continuation of the external-service flow shown in E25 and E26.
screenshots.edits_en: Cropped to the JSON status body, excluding request hosts, query fields, cookies/inspector context and all telemetry URLs/tracking headers. No response text is reconstructed.
screenshots.limitations_en: A pending state is not successful payment or funds transfer. This analyst interaction does not establish a phishing victim, campaign revenue or payment-wallet ownership.

screenshots.caption_en: Filename-search candidates: six scan records cover five distinct domains, including two records for gibtakip[.]net. A filename match alone does not establish identical content or a common operator.
screenshots.edits_en: Cropped the page header and irrelevant outer margin; applied opaque masks to all six live result URLs. The original filename query, search-history limit, result count, relative ages, sizes, and request/IP counts remain visible.
screenshots.limitations_en: The query is limited to recent search history. Relative ages lack a reliable screenshot capture time, and no scan UUID or response hash is visible. The domain mapping is supported by the original private evidence, not readable beneath the masks.

screenshots.caption_en: Resource listing attributed to dosyakontrol[.]net shows api-config.js and e-Devlet-style resource filenames returning GET 200. This image does not display the script body or its hash.
screenshots.edits_en: Cropped outer margins and the final third-party telemetry row, including its long resource identifier. Applied opaque masks to every remaining live hostname/path label and IP address. Original resource filenames, HTTP methods/status codes, sizes, timings, and Cloudflare provider labels remain visible.
screenshots.limitations_en: No scan UUID or acquisition date is shown. The resource listing alone does not independently prove the provenance of saved file E30, an identical script body, a common origin server, or a common operator.

screenshots.caption_en: Two-file local SHA-256 comparison: E08 and E30 have the same digest, which was independently recomputed during the audit.
screenshots.edits_en: Cropped prompt, command, local-user/host information, and file-listing metadata. Applied opaque masks to the remaining local-directory prefixes, including wrapped prefixes, and irrelevant background areas after the filenames. Original digest values and source filenames are retained.
screenshots.limitations_en: This establishes equality of two local files, not independent acquisition from two domains. It overlaps the expanded comparisons in E33 and E35.

screenshots.caption_en: Three-file local SHA-256 comparison: E08, E30, and E32 have the same digest.
screenshots.edits_en: Cropped the prompt and command lines, including the local working directory. The three original digest and filename result lines remain unchanged.
screenshots.limitations_en: This expands E31 to a third local file. Equal hashes do not independently establish acquisition provenance, three-domain deployment, or a common operator.

screenshots.caption_en: Four-file local SHA-256 comparison: E08, E30, E32, and E34 have the same digest. Each file is 18,469 bytes; there is one unique byte content in this group.
screenshots.edits_en: Cropped the local-user/host prompt, working directory, command, and its wrapped continuation. The four original digest and filename result lines remain unchanged.
screenshots.limitations_en: This subsumes the comparisons in E31 and E33. It confirms local byte identity, not independent acquisition from all four attributed domains, full-kit identity, or a common operator.
